title: zask config
description: Project config for zask. The schema checks structure only; zask also checks references between groups, services, and aliases, duplicate names, and whether paths stay within the project root when it loads the config.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor completion and validation. zask ignores this value.

name.description: Project name used for the tmux session and named configs. `zask <name> open` loads the config whose project.name matches.

root.description: Project root directory. `~` and `~/` expand to the home directory.

docker.description: Docker Compose services started by a `{"docker": true}` startup step.

compose.description: Compose file path relative to the project root. Its directory must stay within the project root.

wait_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for Compose services to become ready.

env_file.description: KEY=value files loaded before every service command, relative to the project root.

startup_order.description: Steps run in order by `zask open` and `zask start`. Each step has exactly one of `docker`, `group`, or `command`.

prechecks.description: Commands run before startup to check the environment.

group_aliases.description: Named lists of services that can be used wherever a group name is accepted.

identifier.description: Letters, digits, `_`, and `-`. Must not start with `-`.

envFilePath.description: Path to a KEY=value file. Absolute and `~/` paths are used as is; relative paths must stay within their base directory.

onFail.description: `abort` stops startup when the command fails; `warn` prints the failure and continues.

name.description: Group name referenced by `startup_order`, `start_profiles`, and commands that take a group.

env_file.description: KEY=value files loaded before each service command in this group, relative to the project root.

services.description: Services in this group, as an array of services or an object keyed by service name.

oneOf.description: Command run with `sh -lc` in the service pane. Other settings use their defaults.

name.description: Service name used by commands such as `zask logs <name>`. Unique across all groups. `zask-watch` is reserved for the window that runs file watch and restarts on failure.

command.description: Command run with `sh -lc` in the service pane. Prefixed with `runtime` when set.

dir.description: Working directory relative to the project root. Absolute and `~/` paths are allowed; other paths must stay within the project root unless `external` is true.

runtime.description: Command prefix such as `npm`, so `command: "run dev"` runs `npm run dev`. An empty string means no prefix.

external.description: Allow `dir` to point outside the project root.

port.description: Port the service listens on. The monitor health check requires it.

healthcheck.description: How the monitor checks that the service is ready.

type.description: `tcp` checks that `port` accepts connections; `http` also requests `path` on that port.

env_file.description: KEY=value files loaded before this service command, relative to the service directory.

namedService.description: Service whose name is its key in `services`.

restartOnFailure.description: Restart the service when it exits with a non-zero status or is killed by a signal. A clean exit (status 0), `zask stop`, Ctrl-C in its window, and `zask close` leave it stopped. Restarts happen in the `zask-watch` window, so they continue after the monitor closes or the client detaches.

max_retries.description: Restarts in a row before zask gives up and leaves the service stopped. A failure 30 seconds or more after the last restart, or of a run started by anything other than this restart, starts the count over.

delay_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait after the exit before each restart.

watch.description: Restart the service when these files change. zask scans them about every 0.5 seconds on macOS and Linux and restarts a running or exited service once changes pause for `debounce_ms`; a stopped service stays stopped.

paths.description: Files or directories to watch, relative to the service directory. Absolute and `~/` paths are used as is; relative paths must stay within the service directory.

include.description: Only files matching one of these patterns are watched. Watch every file when omitted. Files listed directly in `paths` are watched regardless.

exclude.description: Files and directories matching these patterns are not watched. `.git`, `.hg`, and `.svn` are always excluded.

debounce_ms.description: Milliseconds without further changes before changes are reported together.

watchPattern.description: Glob relative to each watched path. Without `/` it matches a file or directory name at any depth; with `/` it matches the whole relative path. `*` and `?` stay within a name, `**` matches any number of directories, and a trailing `/` is ignored.

group.description: Group or group alias to start.

wait_ports.description: Ports to wait for before the next step.

port_wait_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for each port in `wait_ports`.

command.description: Command run with `bash -c` before the next step.

dir.description: Working directory relative to the project root.

commands.description: Commands that replace `command` when the matching start profile is selected, keyed by profile.

command.description: Command run with `bash -c`. A non-zero exit counts as a failure.

hint.description: Message shown when the precheck fails.

dir.description: Working directory relative to the project root.

profile.description: Profile name that selects entries in command step `commands`.

label.description: Label shown when this profile starts.

group_overrides.description: Groups replaced while this profile starts, mapping a startup group to the group or alias used instead.
